body:
Filing gate: ① defect. Class **(b)** — a published declaration that disagrees with what the runtime emits.

Filed by the `domain:spec` execution seat (`session_013RDBh5DqXd2xnLwvHLgLFr`) as a carrier falsified by the #16245 round. ⛔ Not graded, ⛔ not routed — the fix lands in `packages/client`, outside this seat's lane.

## The carrier

```
packages/client/src/index.ts:2151

```

## What falsifies it

PR #19683 (card #16245) removes the bracketed lowercase openers from the two `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` producers, on the 2026-08-29 maintainer ruling that `error` is human language and `code` is the machine token. After it lands the runtime emits the sentence with `NO_DRAFT` on the `code` axis and no `[no_draft]` opener in the message.

⇒ this JSDoc is a **present-tense claim about current behaviour** and becomes false. It is not release-note prose recording what a past version shipped.

## Measured

`git grep -n "does not read it\|\[no_draft\]"` over the tracked tree at `origin/main`, dark control on a near-miss spelling → 0 hits, so the probe discriminates. This line is one of the hits that survives outside #16245's declared file surface.

⚠️ Whether the JSDoc ships in the package's `.d.ts` is **NOT MEASURED** here. If it does, the correction is a published-surface change and wants a changeset; if it does not, it is source-only. Settle that against the package's own `files[]` after a real build before choosing the level.
